title: Evaluate progress, merge and exact-contract dependency facts
preconditions: Use provider and consumer with required merge unit primary, and separate progress_done, merge_integrated, contract_fulfilled dependencies; contract gate pins handoff v1.

steps.action: Advance provider progress through in_progress to done; evaluate the progress and merge dependencies.
steps.expected_result: Progress dependency is satisfied; merge dependency stays unsatisfied with merge_not_integrated or merge_conflicted.

steps.action: Record planned, ready and integrated merge events with exact head and merge OIDs; evaluate merge dependency.
Create handoff v1 between the same endpoints, fulfill its lifecycle and evaluate its exact-revision dependency.
Query work-items/readiness before each fact is met, including fixtures with competing progress/merge/contract heads.
steps.expected_result: Every unmet dependency is named by identity with its exact unsatisfied or conflicted fact; no blocker is omitted.

steps.action: Attempt dependency definitions with unknown gate, missing contract revision, and a progress gate also carrying a contract revision.
steps.expected_result: Each invalid or combined condition is rejected without publication.

expected_result: Only the declared fact opens each explicit gate and unmet facts stay explainable.
